info.title: HeroTech Event Booking API
info.description: Versioned REST API for event management and concurrent booking.

post.description: Creates a pending booking reservation for the authenticated user.

409.description: User already has an active booking for this event

message.example: You already have an active booking for this event.

get.description: Returns details of a specific booking owned by the authenticated user.

403.description: Forbidden — booking belongs to another user

message.example: You are not authorized to view this booking.

delete.description: Cancels a booking owned by the authenticated user.

403.description: Forbidden — booking belongs to another user

message.example: You are not authorized to cancel this booking.

post.description: Processes a fake payment for a pending booking. Success confirms the booking; failure cancels it.

No payment found for this booking.

post.description: Confirms a pending booking for the authenticated user.

403.description: Forbidden — booking belongs to another user

message.example: You are not authorized to confirm this booking.

409.description: Booking cannot be confirmed (not pending or event is full)

message.example: Only pending bookings can be confirmed.

get.description: Returns a list of events with optional filtering, search, and sorting.

parameters.name: filter[upcoming]
parameters.description: Filter to events with a start date in the future

parameters.name: filter[has_spots]
parameters.description: Filter to events that still have available capacity

parameters.name: filter[start_from]
parameters.description: Filter events starting on or after this date

parameters.name: filter[start_to]
parameters.description: Filter events starting on or before this date

post.description: Creates a new event. Validates required fields, future start time, end after start, and prevents scheduling conflicts with existing events.

422.description: Validation error (invalid fields or scheduling conflict)

get.description: Returns the details of a specific event.

put.description: Updates an existing event. Validates scheduling conflicts and capacity against confirmed bookings.

403.description: Forbidden — only the admin who created the event may update it

422.description: Validation error (invalid fields, scheduling conflict, or capacity below confirmed bookings)

delete.description: Deletes an event. Cannot delete events with active confirmed bookings.

403.description: Forbidden — only the admin who created the event may delete it

409.description: Cannot delete event with active confirmed bookings

message.example: Cannot delete event with active bookings.
